# Heretic Live

> Independent third-party telemetry for the Heretic model ecosystem on Hugging Face. Heretic Live is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Heretic maintainers (p-e-w/heretic).

Heretic Live is a continuously refreshed count of public Heretic models on
Hugging Face and their combined downloads. It answers one recurring question
about the upstream project: how many public Heretic models exist, and how
widely are they distributed?

Figures are published in the HTML of the homepage so text-only agents can read
them, and are refreshed every 12 hours. The JSON endpoint is the authoritative
machine-readable surface and carries an `updatedAt` timestamp.

## Key URLs

- [Homepage](https://heretic.sdad.pro/): Global reach index and creator lookup.
- [JSON endpoint](https://heretic.sdad.pro/api/stats): Authoritative totals. Append `?username=<hf_name>` for a creator-scoped readout.
- [Upstream question this index answers](https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/issues/450): p-e-w/heretic#450, "Counting publicly available Heretic models and their downloads", opened 2026-09-14. It contains the reference counting script and the original figures (7,509 models / 64,904,090 lifetime downloads / 14,438,920 in 30 days). Heretic Live implements that same approach and refreshes it continuously.
- [Hugging Face model search](https://huggingface.co/models?search=heretic): Upstream public search.

## Current figures

Read them from the JSON endpoint rather than from this file or the homepage.

- `totals.modelCount`: unique indexed repositories
- `totals.allTimeDownloads`: combined lifetime downloads
- `totals.last30DaysDownloads`: downloads in the trailing 30 days

The homepage headline total is projected forward from the 30-day mean and is an
estimate, not a measurement. Prefer the JSON endpoint for any quoted number.

## Data methodology

Two parallel passes over the public Hugging Face Hub API: `filter=heretic` for
repositories carrying the `heretic` tag, and `search=heretic` for repositories
with "heretic" in their model name. Both are sorted by downloads and paginated
through the Hub cursor. The result sets are merged and deduplicated by
repository ID, with the tagged pass taking precedence on collision, then summed
into lifetime downloads, the rolling 30-day counter, and a unique model count.

Tag-only counting undercounts substantially, because many Heretic models are
never tagged. That is why both passes run.

## Data fields

- `modelCount`: unique repositories after deduplication.
- `allTimeDownloads`: sum of Hub `downloadsAllTime` across indexed repositories.
- `last30DaysDownloads`: sum of the Hub rolling 30-day `downloads` counter.
- `updatedAt`: ISO-8601 timestamp of the snapshot.
- `source`: provenance string for the underlying query.
- `scope`: `global` or `user`.

Creator queries return that creator's ranked public models with lifetime and
recent downloads. There is no authentication, no account, and no private
repository access on any surface.

## Limitations

- Public metadata only. No authentication, no private repositories.
- `last30DaysDownloads` is the Hub's rolling 30-day counter summed per model. It
  is not a calendar month.
- "Heretic" is matched as a tag or as a name substring, so a repository that
  uses the tool without naming or tagging it is not counted.
- Upstream Hub outages produce a degraded response carrying the last published
  snapshot rather than a partial total.
